title: Freelancing vs Entrepreneurship: Which Path Is Right for You?
seoTitle: Freelancing vs Entrepreneurship: Which Is Right for You?
seoDescription: Freelancing vs entrepreneurship compared: risk, money needed, income pattern and scalability, who each suits, and how to grow freelancing into a business.
excerpt: Freelancers sell their skills; entrepreneurs build businesses. Compare risk, start-up money, income and scalability, see which path suits you, and learn how to turn freelance work into a business in India.
